alias: Den tall lamp on with sideboard lamp
description: Turns the den tall lamp (WiZ) on when the sideboard lamp's plug goes from under 1 W to 1 W or more (owner, 2026-10-23). The plug measures whole watts, and the sideboard lamp at its lowest setting draws under 1 W and reads 0, so that setting cannot be seen; at its highest it draws 9 W. Fires only on that change between two real readings: a reading coming back from unavailable never counts, and there is deliberately no re-check on HA start or reload, so the tall lamp can still be used on its own. Pair: den_tall_lamp_off_with_sideboard_lamp. Source: tools/ha/automations in the HomeAssistant repo.
